item.title: ASUS ROG XBOX Ally X20 Launch Marks 20‑Year Milestone
item.description: ASUS marks ROG’s 20th anniversary with the XBOX Ally X20 handheld, now with a 7.4‑inch HDR OLED display, sleek chassis and an AR‑glass bundle option.
